records.name: Batikh Batikh
records.summary: A free pop-up cinema and gallery that screens films from Southwest Asia and North Africa and gives shows to women and queer artists.
records.what_you_do: Go to a free screening or exhibition. Artists who want a show can ask through the contact page.

schedule.text: No fixed schedule published. Screenings and exhibitions are announced on the site.

cost.text: Free. Admission is free to the public.

first_step.how: Check the site for the next screening and come along, or email the group to ask about open calls
first_step.basis: Screenings are free and open to anyone, with a published email contact

records.notes: The site has no dated events or posts. Image upload dates (May 2023) are file metadata, not evidence. Status is probably_active only because the site works.

records.name: Caribbean Community in Philadelphia
records.summary: A Philadelphia group that puts on Caribbean heritage events, including a Heritage Day kickoff, a film screening and a children's storytime.
records.what_you_do: Come to a public event such as Caribbean Heritage Day, a film screening or a children's storytime. Watch the CultureWorks community calendar for the next one.

schedule.text: June 2026 events (Caribbean Heritage Month): Heritage Day on June 6, a Queer Caribbean Shorts screening on June 23, and a children's storytime on June 24. No regular schedule published.

cost.text: Not published in the calendar listing

first_step.how: Watch the CultureWorks community calendar for the next Caribbean Community event and come to a public one
first_step.basis: Events are public and listed on a community calendar

records.notes: The group's own site returned HTTP 404 at both the www and bare address, so no website or contacts are recorded. Facts come only from the CultureWorks June 2026 listing, which gives no addresses or prices for these events. Heritage Day was listed at 926 Market Street per a search result; not confirmed on a page we read. Lead: United Caribbean Association of Philadelphia (UCAP) runs the Philadelphia Caribbean Carnival; it is a different group and not verified, see leads_only.

records.name: CultureWorks Greater Philadelphia
records.summary: A Center City nonprofit that handles the paperwork for more than 90 creative projects and rents affordable desk space to cultural workers.
records.what_you_do: Attend a networking or professional development event for cultural leaders, rent a desk in the coworking space, or apply to have your project fiscally sponsored.

schedule.text: Events are posted on the site. No regular schedule is published on the home page.

cost.text: Desk membership prices are in the member portal, not shown on the home page

first_step.how: Email info@cultureworksphila.org or sign up for the newsletter, then come to the next networking event
first_step.basis: Networking events are open to cultural leaders, but fiscal sponsorship needs an application and desk space needs membership

records.notes: This is a service organization for cultural groups, not a community group. The public way in is events, the coworking space and sponsorship. Home page shows no dated events, so status rests on a working site only.

records.name: Dancefusion Inc
records.summary: A Philadelphia dance nonprofit with a year round school for children and adults, plus a junior company that trains dancers in ballet, modern, jazz, tap and hip-hop.
records.what_you_do: Take a class at the Gwendolyn Bye Dance Center, or ask about the fusion2 junior company for dancers who want to train and perform.

schedule.text: Classes run year round for children and adults. Class times are not on the home page.

cost.text: Class prices are not published on the home page

first_step.how: Email mary@gbyedance.org or call 215-222-7633 to ask about class levels and a first class
first_step.basis: Classes are open to children and adults and the school publishes a direct contact

records.notes: The site is named for the Gwendolyn Bye Dance Center, the school within Dancefusion Inc. The only dates are in image file names, so status rests on a working site. Summer programs, events and calendar pages are linked but were not read.

records.name: DesignPhiladelphia
records.summary: A design nonprofit that runs a yearly design festival, awards, school programs and public events so people can see and join in local design.
records.what_you_do: Go to a festival event, exhibition, talk or party, or fill in the volunteer survey on the site. Membership is a free sign up.

schedule.text: The 2026 festival runs September 30 to October 11, 2026. The Beaux Arts Ball is on October 24, 2026 at Girard College.

cost.text: Cost for the ball is not published. Festival registration is on the site.

first_step.how: Register for a festival event on the site, or fill out the volunteer survey
first_step.basis: Festival events are public and sign up is free with no fees listed

records.notes: No exact design tag exists, so categories use arts-crafts and science-learning with talks_lectures as the closest tag. Volunteer and membership pages were linked but not opened. The listed news items have no dates.

records.name: DiasporaDNA Story Center
records.summary: A cultural center at Cherry Street Pier with a large archive of photographs, books and records, that also helps people research family history and record their own stories.
records.what_you_do: Visit the archive during open hours, book a family history or youth program, or come to a summit or festival.

schedule.text: Open Wednesday to Friday, 12 to 6 pm, and by appointment

cost.text: Visit cost is not stated. The Kinkeeping Summit is described as free.

first_step.how: Stop by on a Wednesday to Friday afternoon to explore the archive, or book a program through the site
first_step.basis: Posted open hours and a booking option make the way in clear

records.notes: The only dated item is the Kinkeeping Summit and Holiday Market listed as 11/21 with no year, so status is probably_active on a working site. Membership prices and volunteer roles are not published. Events and Festivals pages were linked but not read.

records.name: EgoPo Classic Theatre
records.summary: A Philadelphia theater company that stages its own productions each season, with subscriptions and memberships for people who want to see every show.
records.what_you_do: See a show by buying a single ticket or a subscription. Memberships add a drink package and gala tickets. The Volunteer page is linked but does not describe roles.

schedule.text: Each season has a few shows with limited runs. Dates are on the site, not in the text we read.

cost.text: Basic Subscription is $80. Memberships run $150, $300 and $500. Single ticket prices are not listed.

first_step.how: Buy a ticket for the next show through the site, or start with the $80 Basic Subscription
first_step.basis: Anyone can buy a ticket to a public show; the group is a professional company, so there is no class or volunteer program on the page

records.notes: Shows are for the 26 to 27 season, with no month or year on the page, so status is probably_active. Volunteer, internship and school residency pages are linked but were not read. Hours are Monday to Friday, 10 am to 4 pm.

records.name: Eleone Dance Theatre
records.summary: A Philadelphia modern dance company that performs historical and new dance works that explore themes across generations and cultures, with a second company and an arts in education program.
records.what_you_do: See a performance, book the company for a show, or ask about the Second Company and Arts in Education programs.

schedule.text: Upcoming shows listed: a Black History show in February 2027, a Spring 2027 concert, and a school recital on June 7 (year not shown).

cost.text: No prices published. School recital tickets are sold at the door.

first_step.how: Watch the performances page for the February 2027 show and buy a ticket when it opens
first_step.basis: Shows are open to the public, though no classes or membership are listed

records.notes: Future shows are listed, but the newest dated news post in the archive is February 2023, so the status is probably_active. Venue for performances varies (the school recital is at Audenreid); only a P.O. Box address is published, so no location is recorded. The site does not mention classes or volunteering.

records.name: Esperanza Arts Center
records.summary: The Latino arts and culture center in North Philadelphia. It presents music, dance, theater, film and art from Latin America and the Caribbean, with family and community events.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a dance, music, film or family show, go to a gallery opening, or apply to the open call for artists. Workshops for neighborhood students and families are mentioned, with no sign up details.

schedule.text: Listed events: October 10 (flamenco, 3 to 5 pm), October 24 (a family dance afternoon, 3 to 5 pm), November 7 (rumba, 3 to 5 pm) and November 19 (artist residency talk, 6:30 to 8:30 pm). Year not shown on the page, presumed 2026.

cost.text: Prices are on each event's ticket link, not in the calendar listing

first_step.how: Pick a family or dance event on the calendar and buy a ticket through its link, or write to patronservices@esperanza.us about the workshops
first_step.basis: Public events have ticket links and a box office, and the center is open to the community

records.notes: The site lists upcoming events without a year, so the 2026 year is presumed from the date we saw it. Membership and volunteering are not mentioned. Season tickets and subscriptions are offered.

records.name: Food bEeatz
records.summary: We could not confirm what this group does. Its only public link is a YouTube channel with a food name.
records.notes: Tried. The channel page returned only its title, with no about text, video dates or contact. One web search for the name found nothing relevant. Kind, categories, interests and audience were not established, so this record is held back until someone with the channel open can check it. Brief said to keep unknown records.

records.name: Imaginary Lines
records.summary: An artist collective that shows artists' work through exhibitions and film screenings, and collects stories from people through a share form.
records.what_you_do: Send a story through the Share Your Story form, or write by email to ask about showing work or screening a film.

cost.text: No cost is mentioned for sharing a story or writing in.

first_step.how: Email imaginarylinesproject@gmail.com to ask about exhibition or screening opportunities, or submit a story on the site
first_step.basis: Anyone can write in or submit a story through a public form

records.notes: The site has no dates and lists no events, so status is probably_active only because the site works. The email is written out on the page to avoid bots. The Support page was linked but had no content in our read.

records.name: IMPeRFeCT Gallery
records.summary: An art gallery in Germantown. We could not read its exhibitions or how to take part.
records.notes: Tried. The site is a frameset that loads a Squarespace page, and that page failed with a TLS certificate name mismatch, so exhibitions, classes, open calls and contacts were not read. The only description is the page's meta text, which places it in Germantown. Interests, kind and audience are not established, so this record is held back until someone can open the gallery's real page.

leads_only.name: United Caribbean Association of Philadelphia (UCAP)
leads_only.note: Runs the Philadelphia Caribbean Carnival and Parade per a search result; not checked. Its page is a donation platform, so its own site is needed.

leads_only.name: Philadelphia Caribbean Festival (organizer not named)
leads_only.note: Free festival at Cherry Street Pier on August 16, 2026 per a search result; organizer not named in what we saw.

leads_only.name: Philly Queer Book Club
leads_only.note: Named as co-host of the Queer Caribbean Shorts screening on the CultureWorks June 2026 listing; not checked.

notes: Budget: 2 WebSearch calls used of 2 (cap reached, none left). 16 WebFetch calls used. Caribbean Community in Philadelphia site returned HTTP 404 at both the www and bare address, so no website is recorded (not a block). Food bEeatz and IMPeRFeCT Gallery have too little readable content, so their records are marked low confidence and held back from going live until a person checks them. Five groups have only a working site with no dates, so their status is probably_active rather than active. Esperanza and Caribbean Community dates were read from listings; Esperanza year is presumed 2026. DesignPhiladelphia and DiasporaDNA kinds are nonprofit per batch.
